message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (based on the federal public‑holiday calendar).  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend. (If the holiday falls on a weekend itself, it still counts as a long weekend because you get the full weekend off.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Jan 1–2 (Sun–Mon) | Holiday on a weekend – still a long weekend. |
| **Family Day** *(Ontario, Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, etc.)* | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 (Sat–Mon) | Provincial holiday; not national. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) | National holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) | National holiday. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Jul 1–2 (Sat–Sun) | Holiday on a weekend – still a long weekend. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) | National holiday. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) | National holiday. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday, Nov 11 | Nov 11–12 (Sat–Sun) | Holiday on a weekend – still a long weekend. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) | National holiday. |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday, Dec 26 | Dec 24–26 (Sat–Tue) | Holiday on a weekday; the weekend is extended to Tuesday. |

**Quick Takeaway**

- **10 long weekends** in total (including those where the holiday falls on a weekend).
- If you’re planning trips, the most popular long weekends are usually around **Good Friday, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas**.
- Remember that **Family Day** is only observed in certain provinces, so it may not apply to everyone.

Feel free to plug this list into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays or more detailed dates, let me know.
